description: This Java test class performs unit testing for the ResetConnectionMetrics class within the connectivity modification commands of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies methods like equals/hashCode, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ResetConnectionMetricsTest
classes.description: Unit test for the ResetConnectionMetrics class, validating equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path correctness.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of ResetConnectionMetrics are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ResetConnectionMetrics are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResetConnectionMetrics instance with a null ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that deserialization from JSON produces the expected ResetConnectionMetrics object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that serialization to JSON produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the resource path returned by ResetConnectionMetrics is as expected.
